title: Vanilla Paste
description: A vanilla-compatible client-side modpack with all the (currently available) bells and whistles
body:
# Description

This is a client-side quality-of-life modpack designed with two goals in mind:
* Full compatibility with both vanilla servers and modded servers with only server-side mods
* Provide immediate visual access to every aspect of the game state that a vanilla server reveals

As 26.1 is still very recently released at the time of writing this (March 29th, 2026), this pack is still in a very early state and I do intend to add the additional mods listed below as they are ported.

# Modlist

### Currently Present Mods
[Advancements Fullscreen](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancements-fullscreen): Full-screen advancement UI  
[AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin): Food-related HUD improvements  
[Bad Packets](https://modrinth.com/mod/badpackets): Better network interoperability between modloaders  
[Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads): Adds fun little player head icons to the in-game chat  
[ClickThrough Plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/clickthrough+): Allows for clicking on container blocks through signs and item frames  
[Controlify](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlify): Controller support  
[Controlling](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlling): Adds a search bar to the keybind menu  
[EffectTimerPlus](https://modrinth.com/mod/effecttimerplus): Adds a level and time indicator to status effect HUD widgets  
[Global Packs](https://modrinth.com/mod/globalpacks): Adds a single global datapack for the server that this pack was designed for  
[Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris): Shader support  
[Item Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-tooltips): Adds tooltips to enchantments and some items  
[Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade): Gives basic info on the currently focused block  
[Pickup Notifications](https://modrinth.com/mod/pickup-notifications): Adds HUD popup when picking up items/XP  
[Reliable Recipe Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrv): In-game recipe viewer. **Due to engine limitations, this mod will not work until a single-player world has been loaded each time the game is run**  
~~[Remove Reloading Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrls): Removes the reloading screen when changing active resource packs~~ **Removed due to incompatibility with Controlify.**  
[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium): Rendering optimizations  
[JourneyMap](https://modrinth.com/mod/journeymap): In-game world map and minimap  
[Light Overlay](https://modrinth.com/mod/lightoverlay): Adds an in-game light level overlay, mostly for spawn-proofing   

### Mods I intend to add when they (or an alternative) are ported
[Cherished Worlds](https://modrinth.com/mod/cherished-worlds): Allows for favoriting worlds to prevent accidental deletion  
[Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons): Amplified view distance  
[Forgematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/forgematica): In-game schematic viewer/planner  
[Traveler's Titles](https://modrinth.com/mod/travelers-titles): Adds HUD popup when entering biomes/dimensions

### Resource Packs
Note: All of these are disabled by default, I just have them included for my own personal convenience

[Programmer Art+](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/programmer-art-plus): Consistency fixes for programmer art textures, which are of course the only *correct* way to play the game  
[Sapphic Serenity](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/lesbian-gui-texture-pack+): Plasters the game in lesbian flags. This one is mostly just for me tbh.  

There are also numerous popular shader packs included in this modpack, though shaders are off by default for those on low-end devices.
